Functional description

The CODE control unit M20 is supplied at pin 3 by the battery from the line for the maxifuse EFI (UGD) of B5 and is protected by fuse B35 .

The supply controlled by the ignition (15/54) reaches pin 8 through the line protected by fuse B25 .

Pin 4 is earthed.

The line leading from pin 6 is a serial line leading to engine management unit M10 , which is responsible for identifying the key and exchanging codes.

It is possible to 'read' the control unit autodiagnostic system, by connecting to the autodiagnostic connector R10 from pin 5 of the control unit M20 .

The autodiagnostic system also produces the signal for the 'CODE failure' warning light, located in the instrument panel E50 : it involves an earth signal coming out of pin 2 of the control unit M20 .

The instrument panel E50 is controlled by the ignition (INT) at pin 19 of connector A from the line protected by fuse F1 of the junction unit B1 : when an earth signal reaches pin 6 of connector B, the 'CODE failure' warning light comes on.

A second control unit connector is connected via two leads to the aerial, fitted coaxially to the ignition key, in order to detect the insertion and rotation of a key with a transponder.
